record: Row-level integrity audit (confirmatory 4v4 entity-repair specialist crossover, 17800001-17800128)
raised_by: eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py's own built-in tie/reversal check (mean<=0.0 on either delta). Wrote CONFIRMATORY_B3_ENTITY_REPAIR_SPECIALIST_CROSSOVER_EVAL_INTEGRITY_REQUIRED.json and refused to write a verdict-bearing result, exactly as designed.
triggered_by: delta_B_spec mean is negative (-0.0859), which alone is enough to trip the check regardless of confidence interval width -- distinct from a DECISIVE reversal (see classification below).
per_cell_integrity: all 4 cells (pi_A@A, pi_A@B, pi_B@A, pi_B@B) independently checked: exactly 128 rows each, seeds unique, seed set EXACTLY {17800001..17800128}, win values strictly binary. Win-flag vs (blue>red) checked against all 512 rows: 0 disagreements.
seed_pairing: confirmed identical 128 seed keys present across all 4 cells -- paired design intact.

split_half_check.purpose: confirm each delta's SIGN is a distributed effect across the whole seed block, not an artifact of a subset of seeds.
split_half_check.reading: delta_A stays clearly positive in both halves. delta_B stays negative in both halves, though its magnitude shrinks in the second half (-0.11 -> -0.06) -- consistent direction, no batch-boundary artifact, but a hint of noise rather than a large stable effect.

bootstrap_recomputation.method: independently recomputed from the raw per-episode rows CSV with fresh code, same frozen protocol (paired percentile bootstrap, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7)
bootstrap_recomputation.note: delta_A_spec's entire interval is positive -- a clean, confirmed PASS. delta_B_spec's mean is negative but its interval STRADDLES ZERO (ucb95=+0.0234 > 0) -- this is NOT a decisive reversal like the earlier EXPLORATORY_4V4 case (whose delta_B interval was entirely negative, ucb95=-0.2188). This is a genuine but statistically inconclusive negative point estimate: consistent with either a small true reversal or with noise around a true null.

classification: GENUINE, NON-DECISIVE. Rows are structurally clean (seeds unique 512/512, exact ranges, zero win/margin disagreements, sign-consistent across both seed-block halves) -- not a duplicate-seed artifact, not a corrupted row, not a pairing bug. But delta_B's confidence interval crossing zero means this audit cannot classify it as a confirmed reversal the way the EXPLORATORY_4V4 precedent's decisively-negative interval could. It fails the PRIMARY_GATE's mean>0 requirement outright regardless.
interpretation_licensed_by_this_audit: delta_A_spec passes cleanly (pi_A3 beats pi_B3 on Pole A with a confirmed positive margin). delta_B_spec fails the mean>0 requirement and its interval straddles zero, so it does not confirm complementary specialization on Pole B, but it also does not confirm pi_B3 is DECISIVELY worse against Pole B than pi_A3 is -- the two are statistically indistinguishable there (or pi_B3 is marginally, non-significantly behind). This lands in the frozen spec's precommitted 'only ONE regime specializes -- partial/asymmetric recovery' branch, NOT the 'training unstable' branch (both runs trained with healthy telemetry: ev 0.85-0.98, stable losses, no NaNs) and NOT the 'neither specializes' branch (delta_A clearly did).
PRECOMMITTED_NEXT_STEP_PER_4V4_ENTITY_RE: diagnose the FAILED regime (Pole B / pi_B3) specifically -- do not redesign both. Check whether Pole B's specific mechanic (lock_defender=10, enable_2v1=True -- a more complex, asymmetric multi-threat defensive scenario, distinct from Pole A's simpler defender-gate overlay) stresses the entity representation differently than Pole A does. Do not conclude the entity-repair architecture is wrong in general; delta_A is direct evidence it CAN work.
